findings.claim: Cleanup stops draining stdout and stderr before sending SIGTERM. A trusted child that writes shutdown diagnostics loses those bytes from the returned capture even when capacity remains. If its termination handler writes enough to fill a pipe, it blocks instead of exiting gracefully and is killed after the grace period. Continue bounded draining during termination and reap waiting.
